special_abilities.ability_desc: An Envoy of The Void does not age, nor does it need to eat or breathe. Only violence can bring about the death of one of these NPCs.
An Envoy of The Void gains +5 deflection bonus from it's protection given by the void.
A NPC that starts it's turn within the aura must make a [saveDC] save or take 1d4 Wisdom damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.

The eldritch can survive in the void of outer space and does not need to breathe when in the void. It fly through space at an incredible speed. Although exact travel times vary, a trip within a single solar system normally takes 3d20 months, while a trip beyond should take 3d20 years (or more, at the GM's discretion).

As a free action every 1d6 rounds, the Void Envoy may open it's 'mouth' to open a portal to the void projecting images to NPCs in a 25-foot sphere. NPCs in the sphere take 5d6 Psychic damage and gain a level of madness. A [saveDC] save halves the damage and negates the madness increment effect. This is a Psychic mind affecting effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.
As a move action every 1d6 rounds, the Void Envoy may open a portal to another location within 500ft. This does not cause AOO.
This Creature does not get exhausted or fatigued.

When you use this shout, you and all affected allies gain a +1 morale bonus on damage rolls on their first attack each turn. For every 2 ranks in Diplomacy you possess, this morale bonus to damage is increased by +1. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect.(Bonus +4)
While within the affected area of this tactic, allied NPCs are considered to be flanking as long as they both threaten the same NPC, regardless of their comparative positioning.
Whenever you succeed on an attack action, you may shout as a swift action. You may expend martial focus to make this shout as a free action.

You can warn your allies to protect themselves better against an enemy’s specific attack. When you use this shout, choose one specific ability you know an enemy possesses (such as a dragon’s breath weapon, a practitioner ogre’s brutal strike (exertion), or a specific spell or magical sphere effect an enemy uses, but not all spellcasting). All allies in the radius of this shout gain a +2 competence bonus to saving throws against that specific ability, increasing by +1 for every 5 ranks in Diplomacy you possess. You may expend martial focus to use this shout as an immediate action, but the bonuses from this shout end after one round.  You must know about the ability to warn against it, such as having succeeded a Knowledge check and learned about that ability, witnessing the ability from the enemy, or learning about the ability from another source (such as an ally informing you).  For spherecasting effects, which can be highly mutable, the bonus from this shout applies to the base ability used rather than an exact combination of talents. For example, this shout can be used in reaction to a destructive blast, and would apply to an unmodified Destruction sphere’s destructive blast or a destructive blast modified by the Energy Strike or Chain Blast talents.

Any ally currently affected by one of your shouts or tactics may spend a move action to restore your martial focus. The NPC spending a move action must have an Intelligence of at least 3 and possess a number of Hit Dice at least equal to 1/2 your total Hit Dice.

special_abilities.ability_desc: The conscript specializes in a combat sphere of his choice. When specializing in a sphere, the conscript gains that sphere as a bonus sphere at 1st level (or a combat talent belonging to that sphere if he already possesses that base sphere) and may treat his base attack bonus as being equal to his conscript level +1 when determining the benefits and effects of that sphere1; if a sphere would grant effects based on the user’s Hit Dice instead of their base attack bonus, the conscript may treat his total Hit Dice as being equal to his conscript level +1 for the purposes of determining what benefits he receives. In addition, he gains a series of abilities associated with that sphere as detailed at the end of the class.
Yelfen may use a move action to aim her weapon, gaining a competence bonus on damage rolls with her next ranged attack equal to 1/2 his base attack bonus (rounded down, minimum 1)(equaling to 5).
Whenever Yelfen makes a successful attack while using the deadly shot ability, she treats any weapon damage dice roll of 1 or 2 as 3.

Yelfen can avoid magical and unusual attacks with great agility. If she succeeds at a Reflex saving throw against an attack that normally deals half damage on a successful save, she instead takes no damage. Evasion can be used only if Yelfen is wearing light armor or no armor.

As a special attack action, you may make an attack with a ranged weapon. You may add any one (snipe) talent you know to this attack.  In addition, you may expend your martial focus to increase the damage dealt by the attack by 1d10, or 1d6 if the attack targets touch AC or is made with a scatter weapon. You must choose whether or not to use this ability before making your attack roll. These extra damage dice are not multiplied on a critical hit, but are added to the total. For every 4 points of base attack bonus you possess, You deal an additional 1d10 damage, or an additional 1d6 if the attack targets touch AC or is made with a scatter weapon.

Snipers specialize in making single, deadly shots, often over great distances. Practitioners of the Sniper sphere can shoot or throw ranged weapons at a NPC engaged in melee without taking the standard –4 penalty on their attack roll. Associated Feat: Precise Shot.

You may regain martial focus whenever you use a move, standard, or full-round action to reload a weapon you are wielding (including nocking an arrow to a bow). If you can normally reload your weapon faster than a move action, you may choose to reload as a move action to gain this benefit.

After performing a deadly shot made while hiding, you may use the Stealth skill’s sniping function as a swift action. You may expend martial focus to reduce this to a free action. In addition, when making a deadly shot, you can deal Fencing sphere precision damage, sneak attack damage, or damage from other similar effects and abilities at any distance.

As long as you have martial focus, whenever you would suffer a miss chance due to concealment, roll the miss chance twice and take the most favorable result. In addition, as long as you have martial focus, you no longer automatically miss when rolling a natural 1 on a ranged attack roll; your attack must still hit the target’s AC as normal. At +10 base attack bonus, you can reroll a result of 1 on a ranged attack roll once per round.

Your ranged attacks are launched with devastating accuracy; whenever you make a ranged attack using the attack action and a spell or ability (such as wind wall or the Deflect Arrows feat) would allow a NPC to prevent or deflect it, that NPC must succeed at a caster level check (if the blocking effect is a spell or supernatural ability) or a combat maneuver check against your attack roll. Failure on this check means that your attack is not impeded by the ability.

If your deadly shot deals damage equal to at least 50% of the target’s current hit points, the target must make a successful Fortitude saving throw or die. Constructs, elementals, swarms, and oozes are immune to this ability. This is a death effect.

When performing a deadly shot, you may ignore the cover bonus to AC granted to targets by anything less than total cover, and the miss chance granted to targets by anything less than total concealment. Total cover and total concealment provide their normal benefits against your ranged attacks. At +10 base attack bonus, you also ignore total concealment.

Your deft movements, physical conditioning, and expert use of your chosen weapons allow you to create a protective barrier around yourself as effective as any true suit of armor. When unarmored and unencumbered, you gain a +3 armor bonus to your AC. This bonus increases by +1 for every 3 points of base attack bonus you possess. Characters who gain Acrobatics as a class skill may instead choose to have the armor bonus increase by +1 for every 3 ranks in the Acrobatics skill they possess.  This bonus to AC applies even against touch attacks or when you are flat-footed. You lose these bonuses when you are immobilized or helpless, when you wear any armor, or when you carry a medium or heavy load. These bonuses do not stack with the AC bonus class feature of the monk or similar abilities.  This bonus depends on an intricate awareness of the practitioner's body and balance, and as such is lost when the target is under any shapeshift other than blank form, or is polymorphed into a NPC of the animal, dragon, elemental, magical beast, plant, or vermin type.

Whenever you use the attack action or an attack of opportunity to attack or disarm a NPC, you deal an additional 1 point of bleed damage to the target on a successful attempt, +1 for every 3 points of base attack bonus you possess; this stacks with any other bleed damage you are capable of dealing. Practitioners of the Duelist sphere never provoke attacks of opportunity when attempting combat maneuvers against a target currently taking bleed damage.  Bleed: Some talents have the (bleed) descriptor; these talents are triggered when you deal bleed damage to a NPC using your blooded strike. You may only apply the effects of a single (bleed) talent to a given attack. A target that is immune to bleed damage is also immune to all other effects of talents with this descriptor. For the purpose of these talents, only bleed damage you deal with your blooded strike is considered when determining their effects.  Disarm: Some talents have the (disarm) descriptor; these talents trigger whenever you succeed at a disarm attempt against a NPC. You may only apply the effects of a single (disarm) talent to a given disarm attempt. (Disarm) talents cannot be applied to maneuvers performed as a free action.

After causing a NPC to begin bleeding, you may spend a move action to regain your martial focus. As part of this move action, you may make a melee touch attack as a free action against a non-bleeding NPC within reach. This attack deals no damage, but causes that NPC to begin bleeding as per your blooded strike. (This does not allow you to apply a (bleed) talent.) Additionally, when an enemy causes you to begin bleeding, you may spend an immediate action to regain your martial focus.  Author's Note: For the intents of this talent, "begin bleeding" refers to any application of a new source of bleed damage that the NPC did not already suffer from, rather than causing a NPC to begin bleeding for the first time.

As a special attack action, you may expend your martial focus to deal an additional 1d4 bleed damage to your target, +1d4 for every 3 points of base attack bonus you possess. This stacks with other bleed damage granted by the Duelist sphere.  Author's Note: Open Vein "stacks" with other sources of duelist bleed, but only with other Duelist sphere bleeds (such as blooded strike and Finger Cutter).

Whenever you deal bleed damage to a NPC, you may cause them to take a penalty on all weapon attack rolls equal to the amount of bonus bleed damage granted to you by blooded strike for as long as the bleed is in effect. Any healing or other ability that ends the bleed also ends this penalty.

Whenever you deal bleed damage as part of an attack action to a NPC who is already suffering bleed damage from your blooded strike, you deal an amount of bleed damage equal to 1 + 1 for every 3 points of base attack bonus you possess. This bleed damage stacks with other bleed damage granted by the Duelist sphere. You can stack this bleed damage with itself once for every 6 points of base attack bonus you possess. This bleed damage is separate from your blooded strike, and does not affect other abilities that scale off of your blooded strike’s bleed damage.
Upon being hit by an attack, Yelfen makes a half of the cumulative damage about to be dealt reflex save. If she succeeds she takes half of the cumulative damage.

As long as a NPC is currently taking bleed damage, their disarm and sunder attempts always provoke attacks of opportunity from you, even if they have an ability that would normally prevent them from doing so.

Your countless Duelist practices have built up thick scar tissue and callouses that provide you protection from bleeding wounds. You gain DR 2 / bludgeoning and reduce all bleed damage you take by 1; bleed damage cannot be reduced below 0 by this ability. For every 5 points of base attack bonus you possess, the damage reduction granted by this ability increases by 2 points and you reduce any bleed damage you take by an additional 1 point.

You are able to deal bleed damage to behemoths, constructs, elementals, and undead, bypassing their normal immunity, though all bleed damage you deal to such NPCs is reduced to half of what it would normally be, to a minimum of 1 point of bleed damage whenever you would successfully deal bleed damage to such a NPC.

Blood Sphere note: The Duelist sphere Ooze Ichor talent allows the user to deal bleed damage to NPC types that are normally immune, but does not by itself make them

special_abilities.abilityName: One with the Void or is it the Null
special_abilities.ability_desc: Gains double it's move speed while moving across Void Tiles.

For each tile [NPCName] moves across it gains 1 collapse charge and for each collapse inflicted gain 2 charges, as an action it can use all charges to explode dealing (5+collapse stacks)d6 to all targets within 10 ft. of it. All targets within this radius must make a [saveDC] on a success half.
Is able to use 1 full round attack action even after moving. If this NPC uses a full round attack action, it instead uses the attack as if it where a full round action twice.
An Envoy of The Void does not age, nor does it need to eat or breathe. Only violence can bring about the death of one of these NPCs.
An Envoy of The Void gains +2 deflection bonus from it's protection given by the void(reduced by 3 from usual 5 due to null corruption).

The eldritch can survive in the void of outer space and does not need to breathe when in the void. It fly through space at an incredible speed. Although exact travel times vary, a trip within a single solar system normally takes 3d20 months, while a trip beyond should take 3d20 years (or more, at the GM's discretion).
This NPC does not get exhausted or fatigued.

ability.ability_desc: Once per round as a reaction Krampus can make a Con Save equal to 10+half the damage taken(round down). On a success take half of the damage(round down).

All NPCs in a 20ft. cone must make a DC 16 Wis Save or be frightened. At the start of it's turn the NPC takes 2d6 physic damage and remake the save. On a success they are immune for the rest of the day.
Once per turn when a NPC takes damage from Krampus they must make a DC 16 Saving throw based off of the D6 rolled(STR(1)-CHA(6)). On a failure take 1 stat damage to that stat.
